name: Wyoming Interstate Medicine Bow Lateral
researcher_notes: The EIA Aug 2026 workbook, sheet Historical Projects (1996-2024), Excel row 141 'WIG Medicine Bow Lateral', lists 149 miles, 24 inch, 275 MMcf/d added, $78 million, completed 25 Nov 1999, FERC CP99-102, states WY and CO. A Federal Register notice of 22 Mar 1999 (docket CP99-102-000) names Wyoming Interstate Company for the Medicine Bow Lateral; the FERC approved projects list for 1997 to 2001 shows the docket. A Natural Gas Intelligence article confirms the 24 inch size (the 149 mile figure appears only in EIA; a search summary of other pages gave about 150 miles). Length and capacity have one origin (EIA); the filing was not opened. Capacity of 275 is EIA's incremental figure; trade press says about 260 MDth/d. Existing row P0282 (Wyoming Interstate Gas Pipeline, 800 mi, 24 in) is the whole system and has no segment for this lateral, so this is staged as its own row under the parent name. It is a separate pipe from the 2001 Medicine Bow Loop (CP00-471). End point is approximate (Cheyenne area mainline); EIA lists WY and CO. Route not researched; no route staged. Check the Bakken xPress note in EIA, which places the lateral in Converse County, WY. Owner spelled per entity_style (Wyoming Interstate Co).
